caption: A hand presses a dry sponge flat, then lifts away as the same sponge gradually regains its shape.

clauses.text: The hand must be positioned directly above the sponge and apply downward pressure to flatten it.
The sponge must visibly compress under the hand's pressure, reducing its height.
After the hand lifts away, the sponge must visibly begin to return to its original shape over time.
The sponge must fully regain its original shape after the hand has lifted away.
